evidence.sql:
SELECT
  w_fo, w_rt, w_pn,
  b_fo, b_rt, b_pn,
  s_fo, s_rt, s_pn,
  z_fo, z_rt, z_pn,
  GREATEST(COALESCE(z_fo, 0), COALESCE(z_rt, 0), COALESCE(z_pn, 0)) AS max_z
FROM (
  SELECT
    w_fo, w_rt, w_pn, b_fo, b_rt, b_pn, s_fo, s_rt, s_pn,
    ABS(w_fo - b_fo) / NULLIF(s_fo, 0) AS z_fo,
    ABS(w_rt - b_rt) / NULLIF(s_rt, 0) AS z_rt,
    ABS(w_pn - b_pn) / NULLIF(s_pn, 0) AS z_pn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      AVG(CASE WHEN CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN CAST('2026-10-22 04:08:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2026-10-22 04:16:00' AS TIMESTAMP) THEN freq_offset_hz END) AS w_fo,
      AVG(CASE WHEN CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN CAST('2026-10-22 04:08:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2026-10-22 04:16:00' AS TIMESTAMP) THEN rise_time_us END) AS w_rt,
      AVG(CASE WHEN CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN CAST('2026-10-22 04:08:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2026-10-22 04:16:00' AS TIMESTAMP) THEN phase_noise_db END) AS w_pn,
      AVG(CASE WHEN NOT (CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN CAST('2026-10-22 04:08:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2026-10-22 04:16:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) THEN freq_offset_hz END) AS b_fo,
      AVG(CASE WHEN NOT (CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN CAST('2026-10-22 04:08:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2026-10-22 04:16:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) THEN rise_time_us END) AS b_rt,
      AVG(CASE WHEN NOT (CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN CAST('2026-10-22 04:08:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2026-10-22 04:16:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) THEN phase_noise_db END) AS b_pn,
      STDDEV_SAMP(CASE WHEN NOT (CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN CAST('2026-10-22 04:08:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2026-10-22 04:16:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) THEN freq_offset_hz END) AS s_fo,
      STDDEV_SAMP(CASE WHEN NOT (CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN CAST('2026-10-22 04:08:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2026-10-22 04:16:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) THEN rise_time_us END) AS s_rt,
      STDDEV_SAMP(CASE WHEN NOT (CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN CAST('2026-10-22 04:08:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2026-10-22 04:16:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) THEN phase_noise_db END) AS s_pn
    FROM SATSENTINEL.rf_observations_simulated
    WHERE sat_id = 'SAT-01'
  ) stats
) zscores
